goal: Run the actual release helut-bench production distinct-lane path at B=65536 on the exact post-ABC 8-bit ripple-adder artifact used by the fresh native-baseline test, export a self-contained workload/result pair, and replay it locally.

artifact.note: The unused clk port sorts first. With 17 declared inputs and B=65536, assignment stride is 2, so clk remains zero while the other 16 bit positions exhaust all 65536 combinations (up to a harmless input-bit permutation).

freshNativeReference.boundary: The native harness is a warmed graph-run median versus a single-threaded Verilator loop that includes input assignment, output reads, and digesting. The production run below has a different versioned digest schema and is not required to reproduce the private native digest.

failurePolicy: Preserve any failure, mismatch, allocation error, timing invalidation, or non-speedup. Do not reduce B, remove output verification, change the circuit, discard timing samples, or select a favorable rerun.
claimBoundary: This closes production-path distinct-lane execution for the exact degree-1 cleartext combinational workload at B=65536. It does not by itself create a symmetric or general native-HDL speed claim, and it says nothing about sequential or encrypted throughput.
